title: Harmony Inn musicians past and present
summary: Players at the Harmony Inn, including Anderson, Big Art, Smitty and Lindsey Ramsey, and where Tommy lives.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. I wanted to ask you about some of the people that have played with you at the Harmony Inn. I know a lot of them have been down there from time to time. Mm-hmm. Who were some of the musicians that have been down there? Nowadays or before? Well, we talked about, let's see, well, nowadays. Who's with you right now?

I wanted to have Anderson on trumpet. Mm-hmm. And Big Art drums. And, uh, beginning Tomorrow Night with Smitty on piano. So. Before then, we'd have such men as, uh, as, uh, Willie Paiju, a trumpet. Edgar Smith on drums. And, uh, I forgot about the name of, Ramsey. Oh, Lindsey Ramsey, yeah. Yeah. He was playing piano. Mm-hmm. What happened to him? Well, he decided to quit. I guess he, as, uh, immediately said he had what? In the mouth?
Maybe he said he got corroded. His mouth was all corroded.
He, he, he must got corroded the fingers because he quit playing. Yeah. He quit playing.
And Tommy. Yeah, well. I never have seen him with anybody else. Did he play with any other bands? No. No. No. Mostly with you through the ears? Mm-hmm. Where does he live in here?
He do, don't, he lives in there on St. Peter and the Villery. Mm-hmm.
I'll run into him sometime, I guess, for the end of the day, but, you know, I don't recognize him.
No. He's all the way down by Joe Propp, Baldwin.
